def node.Advance.spec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (st : NodeDriverState) (es : List EntryM) (L : Option SnapLoan)
    (v : ConfigView),
    st.handling = some (es, L) →
      (∀ (l : SnapLoan), L = some l → l.dlv.length = uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') →
        ⊢
          ∀ Φ,
            (isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                isCluster γ N ∗
                  isNode n γ N id ∗
                    nodeDriver n γ N st ∗
                      advReceipt st.storage st.delivered.length es L ∗
                        nodeConfig n γ N v ∗
                          match L with
                          | none => skippedIn γ st.delivered v.applied st.delivered.length
                          | some l => snapshotCert γ N (snapTrip l.snap l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)) -∗
              ▷
                  ((nodeDriver n γ N
                          { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                            handling := none } ∗
                        nodeAppliedLb γ id st.delivered.length ∗
                          match L with
                          | none => nodeConfig n γ N v
                          | some l =>
                            ∃ m,
                              nodeConfig n γ N { applied := uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index', membership := m } ∗
                                confAt γ (uint.nat l.snap.Metadata'.Index') m ∗
                                  ⌜confStateIs l.snap.Metadata'.ConfState' m⌝) ∨
                      nodeStopped n γ N ∗
                        nodeDriver n γ N
                          { storage := st.storage, delivered := st.delivered, hardState := st.hardState,
                            handling := none } -∗
                    Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                WP
                  ((intoVal (methods node.ty.PointerType go!"Advance" (intoVal n)))
                    (intoVal ()))
                  {{ Φ }}
